known_limitations: No source-native context/document-level ID field exists at all.
No memory-ID-resolvable gold evidence pointer exists for any QA pair (5/146 rows have a partial turn-level has_answer boolean, not a resolvable ID).

qa_pair_ids are not globally unique across the dataset (360/2231 distinct values recur across context-length/hop-variant rows); global uniqueness requires the composite key (split, row_index, qa_pair_id).
qa_pair_ids are documented by the source itself as having been renamed from uuid and bug-fixed across 2025 revisions -- explicit revision instability.
Conflict_Resolution split provides no structural link between an original fact and its contradicting update; the conflict must be discovered from unstructured text.
